description: A shell script for installing and managing various software components and services, including libraries, microservices, and system management tools.

methods.name: check_ret
methods.description: Checks the return code of the last command and exits if it indicates failure.

methods.name: exec_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command, suppressing output, and exits on failure.

methods.name: exec_cmd_verbose
methods.description: Executes a command with output, and exits on failure.

methods.name: install_ms
methods.description: Installs a microservice library file to the designated directory.

methods.name: install_ms_plugin
methods.description: Installs a plugin for a microservice.

methods.name: install_libbbf
methods.description: Builds and installs the libbbf library.

methods.name: install_libbbf_test
methods.description: Builds and installs the libbbf_test library.

methods.name: install_wifidmd_as_micro_service
methods.description: Clones and installs the wifidmd microservice.

methods.name: install_libeasy
methods.description: Clones and builds the libeasy library.

methods.name: install_libethernet
methods.description: Clones and builds the libethernet library.

methods.name: install_ethmngr_as_micro_service
methods.description: Clones and installs the ethmngr microservice.

methods.name: install_netmngr_as_micro_service
methods.description: Clones and installs the netmngr microservice along with related components.

methods.name: install_sysmngr_as_micro_service
methods.description: Clones and installs the sysmngr microservice.

methods.name: error_on_zero
methods.description: Checks if the return code is zero and exits if so.

methods.name: generate_report
methods.description: Generates a test report using tap-junit.

methods.name: install_cmph
methods.description: Clones and builds the cmph library.
